status: metadata-only proposal, not an algorithm freeze or completed experiment
raw_data_access: No raw archive was downloaded, opened, parsed, or evaluated by this preparation agent. Workspace inventory found no previous selfBACK files or protocol mentions.
physical_units: 33 participants in one collection; held-out participants are separate physical participants, not independent sites
target: original nine annotated activity classes; no constructed label threshold

participant_split.rule: Sort original numeric participant IDs using filename metadata before any signal or class outcome is inspected. Ranks1--12 fit,13--20 calibration,21--33 test. Any participant-count/schema mismatch stops the run and is reported; it does not select replacement participants.

adapter.pairing: Same one-second calendar-timestamp bins from original w and t panels. Require at least50 actual raw samples in each device bin. Retain mean, standard deviation, minimum, maximum per axis in the completed bin. A supplied wt panel may be used only after original provenance and timestamp mapping are independently verified.
adapter.chronology: Sort by original participant timestamp; never order segments by target/activity code. Original activity-folder annotation determines the target only. Exclude mixed-label bins before constructing the stream, and record their counts. Predictors contain no target, participant ID, file/activity name, or label-derived boundary.
adapter.lags: Current and two preceding covariate feature rows; reset at participant boundary or an observable timestamp gap >1second, never at a ground-truth class transition alone.
adapter.forecast_outage: Same rotating source forecast is hidden in the first2 of every13 replay windows; raw physical input remains available.
adapter.training_error_holdout: Within the12 fit participants reserve SHA256(participant,timestamp) first8hex modulo10<3 for held-out source quality/error observations; other fit labels fit preprocessing and models. No fit/cal/test participant overlap.
adapter.normalization: Mean/scale from fit-training rows only, scale floor0.05 and feature clip8 standard deviations. No per-test-subject scaling.
adapter.class_mapping: Nine labels fixed by annotation metadata, never chosen using test frequency or utility. Actual file naming requires a metadata-only validation before processing.

service_contract.utility_units: correct served classifications minus declared action/preparation fees; not money or a clinical outcome
service_contract.chains: Each test participant begins from the same fit-only model state, with its own causal history and budget. Actual timestamps and gaps are retained. Four-window leases count prediction opportunities rather than a fixed wall-clock duration.

evaluation.primary_units: 13 withheld physical participants; five artificial delays per participant are repeated scenarios, not additional participants
evaluation.controls: Frozen proposed joint mechanism, strongest same-information marginal/factorized/native non-Bayesian matrix pipelines, full Student-t/KDE/copula conditional laws, objective-trained PDF/QMF and DBF adaptations as feasible. Exact model grids and total tuning/work budgets must be frozen by root before acquisition.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: Participant-level paired full service net increment versus each complete selected pipeline
evaluation.mechanism_endpoint: All shared-state strict score crossings and their realized paid returns; all added gains, avoided losses, missed gains, incurred losses; preserve whole action comparison
evaluation.risk_endpoints: Issued/ready/informative/actually admitted coverage with exact denominators; maximum and summed conservative-target exceedance; harmful leases and negative-return magnitude; ledger maximum committed reserve and budget-rejected action values

acquisition_gate: Root must complete and save a source-closure algorithm/controls/protocol freeze before any raw transfer. This metadata proposal is not that freeze. No observed outcome is promised.
